summary: Frame rate of the generated video. Veo output is 24 fps, and that is what duration arithmetic is based on. Google publishes no list of accepted values for this field on the Gemini Developer API, so treat 24 as fixed rather than as a default you can move.
combines: The field exists on GenerateVideosConfig in @google/genai but carries no documented range, and every published Veo spec quotes 24 fps output.
Clip length is controlled through durationSeconds, not by trading frame rate against duration.
Send a non-24 value only after testing it against the live API: nothing in the docs says it is honoured.
Vertex only. The Gemini Developer API documents no fps field and fixes Veo output at 24 fps, so a value sent here is not honoured.
